Subject: Draft MAP: FinTrust assurance milestone (security review & SOC 2 package)

Emily — thanks again for the call today. Quick post-call recap and the first pass at the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security review / SOC 2 package milestone. Attached: FinTrust_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (MAP), SOC2_questionnaire_FT.pdf (your questionnaire responses template), and evidence_inventory_template.csv.

High-level summary / asks:
- Goal: Complete security review + delivery of SOC 2 evidence bundle to FinTrust by target close date (proposed 2026-03-19).
- What we provided today: access to the runtime performance slides, overview of private deployment options, and transparency around our audit & logging capabilities.
- Next immediate steps for MAP milestone (security):
  1) Redwood: deliver completed SOC 2 questionnaire draft + evidence list (initial) — owner: Rafael Mendes — due: 2026-02-18
  2) FinTrust: review questionnaire, flag any gaps, and provide priority evidence requests — owner: Emily / Security Ops — due: 2026-02-23
  3) Joint: schedule a focused security walkthrough (30-45m) to walk evidence items and dependencies — target week of 2026-02-22.

Dependencies & notes:
- Some artifacts (encryption key handling diagram, retention policy excerpts, and recent penetration test summary) live in our secure drive; Rafael will share limited-access links.
- If FinTrust requires full system logs for a specific date range, we need to agree on scope (sample vs full export) — export turnaround can be 3–5 business days after scope confirmation.

Attached MAP has a milestone tab mapping owners & dates. Please review and tell us where to tighten dates or add checkpoints. Rafael will own assembling the initial evidence list.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0123
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@fintrust.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: FinTrust assurance milestone (security review & SOC 2 package)

Thanks Tessa — helpful summary and appreciate the materials. A couple of clarifications from our side after a quick pass: 

1) Target close date: 2026-03-19 is aggressive but OK if we can lock owners and keep to the timeline. Im thinking we should add an internal FinTrust decision checkpoint on 2026-03-05 (security sign-off to proceed to procurement).

2) Evidence scope: our security team prefers to receive the full SOC 2 questionnaire with answers in PDF and a mapped evidence index (not just CSV). Can you confirm Rafael will produce a consolidated PDF export?

3) Logs request: security-ops asked whether Redwood can provide redacted access logs (authentication & admin events) for the last 90 days. They also want to know the format (CSV vs JSON) and whether timestamps are UTC.

4) Pen test report: wed like a summary and whether findings are open/closed. If the report is under NDA, can we get a summary page and remediation status?

We can do the walkthrough on 2026-02-24 10:00 AM ET — does that work? If so, invite will go to security-ops and Jordan.

Emily
Head of Security Programs
FinTrust Financial

Emily — appreciate the fast follow. Confirming commitments and owners below; Rafael & Aditya will handle artifacts and log deliverables. Weve updated the MAP (attached FinTrust_MAP_v1.3.xlsx) with these items and dates. Highlights: 

A) Redwood commitments (owners & dates):
- Rafael Mendes: Consolidated SOC 2 questionnaire with answers (PDF export) + evidence index (PDF) — due 2026-02-18 EOD PT. Attachment: SOC2_questionnaire_FT.pdf (draft).
- Aditya Rao: Export redacted auth/admin logs (CSV) for prior 90 days — sample export by 2026-02-20, full export scope locked by 2026-02-23 if approved.
- Marissa Cole: Coordinate pen test summary and status with Security & Product — due 2026-02-19.

B) FinTrust commitments (we captured from your note):
- Emily / security-ops: Provide prioritized evidence requests and confirm desired log fields (timestamps, user id, event types) — due 2026-02-23.
- Jordan: Confirm internal procurement checkpoint date (proposed 2026-03-05) and attendees.

C) Milestones & dependencies (in MAP):
- 2026-02-18: Redwood delivers questionnaire + evidence index (Rafael).
- 2026-02-20: Redwood delivers log sample (Aditya). FinTrust reviews and confirms export scope.
- 2026-02-24: Security walkthrough (30-45m).
- 2026-03-05: FinTrust internal decision checkpoint (security sign-off).
- 2026-03-12: Final evidence delivery (per agreed scope).
- 2026-03-19: Target close (contract execution / procurement).

D) Notes on format & access:
- Logs: redacted CSV with UTC timestamps is standard for us; we can also provide NDJSON on request. Sample will include column headings and a short README.
- Pen test: if the full report is NDAed well provide an executive summary PDF and a remediation status table.
- Drive links: Rafael will provision view-only links to the evidence folder and send via secure transfer (we wont attach the pen-test file to email).

E) Action: Rafael, Aditya, Marissa — please confirm delivery dates above or flag if you need more lead time. Emily/Jordan — if the walkthrough on 2026-02-24 10:00 AM ET works, well send a calendar invite and attach the MAP for that meeting as the agenda.

Thanks — Tessa
